question: Murudeshwar Temple is situated on Kanduka Giri in the state of_____
solution:
The correct answer is__** Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Murudeshwara is a temple town in Bhatkala Taluk, **North Canara district** in Coastal Karnataka. 
 
• It is situated on the main **Mangalore-Karwar Highway,** And it is sandwiched between the **picturesque Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea.**
 
• The Murudeshwar temple is built **on the Kanduka hill in the quaint town of Murudeshwar**
 
• The** breathtaking effigy of Shiva** in Murudeshwar is a popular one.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29ef1b9f55cd0e92a59be3d626e61376382a6085b18a5d510cf043e0a3a39ba9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​The Meenakshi**** Amman Temple**, situated in Madurai, is one of the most famous Shiva temples in **Tamil Nadu.** 
 
• **Odisha** is also called the **“Land of Lord Jagannath”,** it means the Lord of all the Universe. 
 
• Jagannath temple is situated in **Puri.**
 
• **Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple** situated in **Thiruvananthapuram is the most famous temple in Kerala**.
